title: e-Bike tour of Barcelona
text: Excellent - first time on an e-Bike - made the climb up to Montjuic and 3 hours on the bike a much easier and much more enjoyable option - easily mastered; Bruno was an excellent Guide too - very knowledgeable
author: Alan G

title: Great time!
text: Was a wonderful way to see many parts of the city.  My guide, Bo was great - Friendly, Helpful, & informative.  There are some uphill sections, but the bikes are electric so I never felt too tired or winded.  It was fun!
author: Lori S
